page.content:
King Arthur, Camelot, and the Matter of Britain from chronicle to romance.

How Arthurian legend connects

  • Work: Le Morte Darthur — Malory's book is the standard English telling of the whole arc.
  • Work: Historia Regum Britanniae — Geoffrey's history made Arthur a European literary king.

What is Arthurian legend?

Arthurian legend is the public-domain Matter of Britain: Arthur's kingship, the Round Table, Lancelot and Guinevere, Merlin, the Grail, and Camlann. Geoffrey of Monmouth, the French vulgate, and Malory fix the main English-language shape.

Key threads lead to Le Morte Darthur and Historia Regum Britanniae.
